C1019.title: Fujitsu ProjectWEB Platform Suffers Unauthorized Access Leading to Data Breach
C1019.summary: Fujitsu disclosed that its ProjectWEB information sharing platform experienced unauthorized access, and some customer data may have been externally accessed or leaked. The current references support the core fact of unauthorized access affecting an information sharing tool, but the specific cause should not be directly attributed to access control failure. The incident reflects security risks in permission management, external exposure, and customer data protection for enterprise collaboration platforms.
